stemMarkdown: What is the combined population, in lakh, of the cities with a literacy rate of 60% or more?
solutionMarkdown:
Cities at or right of the 60% gridline are P (60), S (70) and Q (80). Their bubble figures are the populations:

$30 + 20 + 12 = 62$

**62 lakh**. City P sits exactly on 60 and the condition is "60% or more", so it counts.
